verdict_reason: A verbatim copy of the v3 suite that tests nothing specific to v0.4.0.

todos.issue: PimsLineItemMapperV4Test is PimsLineItemMapperV3Test copied with three lines changed (the class name and the two mapper types). Nothing in it is specific to v0.4.0, so every line-item mapping test now has two homes. Line 31 also carries a bare '// Given' comment.
todos.fix: Must: line-item mapping that is the same in v0.3.0 and v0.4.0 is tested once, with per-version tests only for what differs, and no Given/When/Then comment. One way: share the line-item mapper between versions and keep one suite, or parameterise one suite over both mappers, and delete the comment.
